newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank O/N repo rate 27.01 pct (20.13 pct).
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank O/N repo rate 27.01 pct (20.13 pct).

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Thursday the average rate at its one-day securities repurchase tender rose to 27.01 percent from 20.13 percent in a similar tender on Wednesday.
The NBS added that it had allocated funds totalling 2.0 billion crowns, out of the banks' bids of 4.93 billion crowns.

"We think that this amount, coupled with the continuing individual deals with banks, should be enough to ensure the sector will fulfil today's minimum reserves requirements," NBS Open Market Operation Department Director Peter Andresic told Reuters.
"Maybe some banks will be short (at the minimum reserves), but the sector as such should be fine," he added.
Andresic said the rates in the individual trades with banks were "at around the average rate at the tender".
Maximum bid in the tender was 27.50 percent, while the minimum bid rate was 27.00 percent, the NBS added in a statement.

According to official NBS figures, the banking sector is short of liquidity with banks' minimum reserve demands fulfilled at 98.70 percent as of Wednesday, after being at 98.23 percent the previous day.
